text: The 'ordinal analysis programme' for stronger systems continues to establish proof-theoretic bounds. The current frontier includes which system?
choices: Full second-order arithmetic (Π¹₂-CA₀ and beyond) and large cardinal axioms
explanation: Ordinal analysis: ε₀ (PA), Γ₀ (ATR₀), and beyond into impredicative analysis and set theory are active frontiers.
